question: Why is v4's drain-complete log wrong after discovery removal, and what happens to stale-route s3?

criteria.instruction: Discovery removal only affects routing views and does not finish established s1/s2 streams. v4 kills them at 102 without terminal answers. Gateway snapshots can lag, so s3 can still arrive at 101. D12 first closes local admission and readiness; stale s3 must be explicitly rejected not-admitted before execution. Liveness and readiness are distinct.
Combine D12 with v4 inspection and the selected shutdown timeline; do not equate a discovery acknowledgment with an empty active-stream registry.
Do not claim accepted work finished or remote execution rolled back when the process terminated.
